label: Uncanny
description: Intense psychological horror: an eager gaze, emotional mismatch, oppressive proximity and a sense that something is wrong. No gore.
content: adult characters, fully clothed, non-graphic psychological horror

definitions.expression: unnaturally wide unblinking eyes, small focused pupils, an eager smile that is slightly too broad, looking down directly at the viewer
definitions.pose: leaning forward over the viewer, chin lowered, shoulders relaxed, face held very still
definitions.framing: close-up portrait, low-angle view from below, face looming close to the camera, slightly off-center composition
definitions.atmosphere: psychological horror, unsettling anticipation, oppressive intimacy, stark chiaroscuro, narrow light across the eyes, deep shadows around the face, ordinary surroundings falling into darkness

definitions.expression: a warmly welcoming smile paired with cold unblinking eyes, fixed pupils, a look of patient and inappropriate delight
definitions.pose: standing perfectly still, head tilted slightly to one side, looking directly at the viewer
definitions.framing: head-and-shoulders portrait, slightly canted camera, tight asymmetric framing
definitions.atmosphere: intense psychological horror, emotional mismatch, uncanny stillness, deep charcoal shadows, a small hard light on the face, the darkness behind the figure feels impossibly deep

definitions.expression: eyes opened too wide beneath lowered brows, tiny bright catchlights, a restrained eager grin, intensely watching the viewer
definitions.pose: bending slightly toward the camera, head lowered while maintaining direct eye contact
definitions.framing: tight portrait from below, forehead close to the upper frame, intrusive proximity
definitions.atmosphere: unsettling psychological horror, quiet malevolent delight, threatening patience, harsh oblique illumination, one cheek swallowed by shadow, muted cold colors

definitions.expression: a delighted asymmetric smile, wide intent eyes that never seem to blink, eager recognition directed at the viewer
definitions.pose: leaning into the viewer's space, face turned slightly while the eyes track the camera
definitions.framing: extreme close-up, tilted low camera angle, one eye much closer to the lens, part of the face cropped by the frame
definitions.atmosphere: psychological horror, invasive closeness, something subtly wrong with the perspective, low-key lighting, a hard glint in the eyes, black shadow at the edge of the face

definitions.expression: a small polite smile, unusually wide watchful eyes, fixed pupils, an incongruously pleased and expectant expression
definitions.pose: standing motionless facing the viewer, chin tipped downward, shoulders level
definitions.framing: upper-body portrait seen from below, figure filling the frame, empty space squeezed to one side
definitions.atmosphere: deeply unsettling psychological horror, oppressive silence, uncanny anticipation, pale desaturated light, dense black shadows, familiar surroundings made ominous

definitions.expression: an eager almost-laughing smile that stops at the mouth, intensely focused unsmiling eyes, small pupils, looking down at the viewer
definitions.pose: standing over the low camera, head angled down, upper body inclined forward
definitions.framing: close portrait from a very low viewpoint, foreshortened shoulders, face dominating the composition
definitions.atmosphere: intense psychological horror, wrong emotional timing, predatory eagerness, severe side lighting, deep eye-socket shadows with sharp catchlights, restrained color

definitions.framing: cropped close-up from an oblique low angle, oppressive facial proximity
definitions.atmosphere: uncanny psychological terror, the feeling of being noticed by something pretending to be familiar, hard facial highlights, hollow shadows, a quietly wrong atmosphere
